posts.zh:
dsh-subagent-agy 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。把 Google Antigravity CLI（agy）接入 DSH 作为产品子代理：用 Antigravity 登录态（无需 API key）委托 Gemini 编程智能体干活，支持对话续聊、后台流式进度、按路径识图与自动弹出登录窗口。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-72f06b4e38b0406f19ca.html
posts.en:
dsh-subagent-agy is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Google Antigravity CLI (agy) as a DSH product subagent: delegate tasks to a Gemini coding agent with your Antigravity login (no API key), with conversation follow-ups, background streaming progress, image analysis by path, and a pop-up login window.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-72f06b4e38b0406f19ca.html
